title: medicago falcata subsp. media
intro: Medicago falcata subsp. media, commonly known as a type of wild or yellow melilot, is a perennial legume plant native to Europe, Western Asia, and Africa. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Medicago falcata subsp. media are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which can help to relieve coughs, colds, and other respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
